reasoning_traces.think:
The core failure mode is that unconstrained LLMs hallucinate game outcomes from sportsbook noise rather than NFL coaching physics. This leads to spurious correlations (e.g., r = +0.005, p = 0.95) between closing lines and actual performance. The primitives enforce a causal hierarchy: Coach-First → Physics-Based → Data-Constrained. The compile-time firewall prevents information leakage from noisy derivatives back into the coach-model, while the pairwise deception matrix captures adaptive coordinator behavior that static schemes miss. The endgame kneeldown model provides a concrete, testable prediction about quarterback behavior that can be verified against play-by-play data.
